source_snapshot.items: All SAS/SATA NVMe LED Check - Rebuild
source_snapshot.procedure: Narrative names NVMe RAID rebuild, but the sole step inserts an NVMe SSD and checks Present LED.
source_snapshot.criteria: LED behavior matches the system specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL proposes Locate/raw indicator control, proving neither rebuild nor Present.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Identifies Rebuild-versus-Present and SAS/SATA-versus-NVMe conflicts and requires a disposable controller lifecycle if Rebuild is selected.

old_problem: The title/narrative require Rebuild, the only executable step checks insertion-driven Present, and SAS/SATA grouping conflicts with NVMe; these states and device families are not equivalent.
disposition_reason: ED-01 prohibits RAID0 rebuild but cannot choose between this row's contradictory Rebuild and Present requirements. No authoritative source selects the test state or supplies a real rebuild trigger/recovery. Parameterization would silently choose coverage and is therefore unsafe.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row116 all18 XLSX cells and history2724.
Kept Rebuild, Present and Locate as distinct LED semantics and preserved both conflicting source statements.
Retained the decision because selecting intent or inventing a destructive rebuild state machine exceeds approved rules; no DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: NVMe Rebuild-versus-Present LED testcase pending authoritative intent
test_case.purpose: After engineering selects the source intent, verify either a genuine controller Rebuild LED lifecycle or the literal insertion-driven Present LED without merging those states.
required_package: Authoritative decision: Rebuild, Present, or separately versioned variants; and NVMe versus SAS/SATA scope
If Rebuild: supported controller RAID level, disposable members/replacement, fault/rebuild trigger and phase semantics
If Present: exact SSD/bay topology, supported insertion method and Present LED table
Qualified operator, critical authorization for any rebuild scenario, abort limits and recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not execute while intent is unresolved. If Rebuild is approved, use only the pinned disposable-array controller workflow to prove healthy, degraded/replacement, active progress and completion/rollback while recording physical LED phases. If Present is approved, perform only the supported mapped insertion and detection check. Locate/raw LED control cannot substitute for either.
test_case.expected_result: The selected authoritative state is independently proven in controller/topology evidence and the exact physical bay shows its corresponding OEM LED behavior, with no unintended device or platform fault.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS is impossible until intent is approved. Rebuild requires real controller progress; Present requires insertion/detection. Simple insertion cannot pass Rebuild, and Locate/raw toggling cannot pass either.
safety_gate: Never infer or execute a rebuild trigger from the contradictory source.
Any rebuild uses only disposable non-boot/non-management media and separately approved recovery.
Any insertion follows qualified-operator power/hot-swap and ESD controls.
Abort on wrong identity, unexpected member/LED state, stalled/uncontrolled rebuild, storage/thermal/power/BMC fault or lost recovery; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: OEM Rebuild or Present LED state matrix
Controller rebuild phases or insertion/detection logs, according to selected intent
Timestamped physical LED video, health/log baseline and approved final disposition
test_case.recovery: Do not attempt an inferred rollback. Preserve state and evidence; follow only the recovery matching the approved variant. A degraded array remains isolated until separately authorized, while an insertion case uses only the approved power/hot-swap restoration.

source_conflict.reason: Rebuild title/narrative, Present-only step and SAS/SATA-versus-NVMe taxonomy remain materially contradictory.

blocked.reason: Static review is complete; execution is prohibited until intent and safe variant-specific method are approved.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Select Rebuild versus Present and hardware scope, then provide the matching OEM semantics, topology, operator and recovery.
pending.owner: Test owner, storage/RAID controller, NVMe/backplane and safety owners.
pending.unlock_condition: Approve a single authoritative intent or split variants and supply the corresponding non-equivalent execution/recovery package.

project_authority: Only project authority may resolve the contradictory coverage and authorize a destructive rebuild lifecycle.
